locator: I-II q.94 a.2 co.: Hoc est ergo primum praeceptum legis, quod bonum est faciendum et prosequendum, et malum vitandum
interpretation: The first precept of the natural law, founded on the notion of the good ('Bonum est quod omnia appetunt'); all other precepts of the natural law are founded on it, following the order of natural inclinations. Read as two universal conditionals: what is good is to be done and pursued, what is evil is to be avoided. The Catholic answer to Q-NORMATIVE-REASONS in #185.
